topic: Space of client notes from the operator, queued tasks and unidentified callers
detail: SP-023 places a client Ingest only in the caller's pinned space; the operator at a terminal ('orch ingest'), queued tasks and unidentified callers have none, so under a policy their notes go to quarantine until retagged (SP-071). D-46 says a task writes to its dispatcher's space, but tasks do not record the dispatching session yet (SP-025.1.a8/SP-029). Decide how the operator's own notes are placed (e.g. an operator-only space choice, or the placement of the operator's cwd).
